language.title: Language
language.pickerSubtitle: Choose the language used throughout the app.
language.contributeNote: See wording that reads wrong in your language? Help us fix it — thank you for making Vela better.

localization.numberSubtitle: How amounts are grouped and the decimal mark shown.
localization.dateSubtitle: Order of day / month / year and the separator.

feeSpeed.title: Transaction speed
feeSpeed.subtitle: Every send you start in Vela begins here. You can still change a single one when you send it.

signing.title: Sign with
signing.subtitle: Every signature you start in Vela begins here. You can still choose another way for a single one.
signing.pageSubtitle: The page the Clear Signer opens: the official one, or your own copy of the zero-dependency page.
signing.pageInvalid: That is not a web address.
signing.pageInsecure: Use an https page, or one on this device's own loopback — a browser will not sign anywhere else.
signing.pageForeign: Your passkeys belong to getvela.app. A page on another domain can show a request but cannot sign it.
signing.relaySubtitle: Pairing with another device goes through this relay. It only ever passes on encrypted messages.
signing.relayInvalid: That is not a relay address.
signing.relayInsecure: Use a wss:// address, or ws:// on this device's own loopback.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.subtitle: Report a bug or share an idea

signOut.title: Sign Out
signOut.desc: This device stops being signed in. The wallet itself is not deleted — your passkey stays in Face ID / fingerprint.
signOut.keeps: Choose “I already have a wallet” to sign back in with that passkey: the same address returns, and your history, contacts, tokens and settings are still here.
signOut.warning: Your public key has not reached the sync server yet. It will be retried on the next launch, but until it succeeds you may not be able to sign in on another device — or here, if you remove the app.

eraseDevice.title: Erase This Device
eraseDevice.subtitle: Delete everything Vela stored here
eraseDevice.desc: Everything Vela has stored on this device is deleted. There is no backup and no undo.
eraseDevice.loses: You lose: transaction history, contacts and groups, browsing history, dApp permissions, custom tokens and networks, RPC and endpoint settings, and every preference.
eraseDevice.keeps: You do not lose the wallet. Your passkey stays in Face ID / fingerprint — choose “I already have a wallet” and the same address comes back, empty of history.
eraseDevice.failed: The erase did not finish. Some data is still on this device and you are still signed in — try again.

networks.saveHint: Saved as soon as you leave the field. It is refused only when the RPC reports a different chain ID.

storage.title: Device storage
storage.subtitle: Local data and cache
storage.userData: Your data · cannot be recovered once cleared
storage.clearBody: Balance, token and rate caches are cleared and re-fetched the next time you open the app. Your transaction history, contacts and settings are not affected.

indexDown.title: Service temporarily unavailable
indexDown.subtitle: The passkey index can’t be reached, and both creating and signing in need it.
